title: The Rebellious Commons
text: The guilds have shut the city gates and will not open them until the Houses hear their grievances. Barricades go up in the lanes. Their spokesman is a woman nobody can remember electing, who speaks of the Gate as if she had been through it, and does not blink.

outcomes.text: The gates open. The spokesman laughs on the gallows, and the people do not look the Houses in the eye.
The grievances are fair, and the Houses answer them. The spokesman is gone the next morning.
The hearing becomes a riot. In the crush, the spokesman is seen walking calmly toward the Gate.
Coin opens gates. It does not open faces.
